description: Which bytes change when one variable field of one row (Pg.T1 of row 2) grows by 60 characters (120 UTF-16 bytes) from 61 to 121 characters, by one UPDATE? Pg: 12 rows, ID and eight Text(255) fields T1..T8, each holding 61 repetitions of U+20AC (122 UTF-16 bytes of value; the character lies outside Latin-1). Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
